sourceCommand: docker exec -e PGPASSWORD=*** ita-identity-session-postgres psql -U app_user -d intelligent_teaching_assistant -t -A -F "|" -c "select indexname from pg_indexes where schemaname='public' and tablename='identity_sessions' order by indexname;"
